scope: Chapter 1 proves potential, all-weight ideal-type and analytic descent through critical fibers of a connected-fiber holomorphic map to a compact curve, together with the local Lelong pullback formula and L1 continuity. Chapter 16 extends the entire zero-mass model-space metric to these maps: the Gauduchon trace respects Borel restrictions and scheme fiber multiplicities.
